python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
p=Path.home()/"Library/Application Support/youchu-agent-bus/state/youchu_ai_sent.json"
obj=json.loads(p.read_text())
# structure?
if isinstance(obj, list):
    items=obj
elif isinstance(obj, dict):
    items=obj.get('messages') or obj.get('sent') or obj.get('items') or []
    if not items:
        # maybe keyed by bus id
        for k,v in list(obj.items())[:5]:
            print('key sample', k, type(v).__name__)
        items=[]
        for k,v in obj.items():
            if isinstance(v, dict):
                v=dict(v); v['_k']=k; items.append(v)
            elif isinstance(v, list):
                items.extend(v)
print('n items', len(items) if isinstance(items,list) else type(items))
# filter today
cnt=0
for it in (items if isinstance(items,list) else []):
    s=json.dumps(it,ensure_ascii=False)
    if '2026-11-04' not in s and '11-04' not in s: 
        # check time fields
        ts=str(it.get('ts') or it.get('created_at') or it.get('sent_at') or '')
        if '2026-11-04' not in ts: continue
    text=(it.get('text') or it.get('body') or it.get('content') or '')
    if not text and isinstance(it.get('payload'),dict):
        text=it['payload'].get('text') or ''
    bid=it.get('reply_to_bus_id') or it.get('bus_id') or it.get('_k') or ''
    kind=it.get('kind') or it.get('type') or ''
    if '2026-11-04' in json.dumps(it,ensure_ascii=False) or True:
        ts=str(it.get('ts') or it.get('created_at') or it.get('sent_at') or '')[:19]
        if ts.startswith('2026-11-04') or '2026-11-04' in json.dumps(it.get('meta',{}),ensure_ascii=False):
            print(ts, kind, '->', bid, (text or s)[:280])
            print('---')
            cnt+=1
print('matched', cnt)
